description: ((x & 2) * 9) & 22 not folded to (x & 2) * 9: known zeros of a multiplication by a power-of-two-or-zero value lost
notes: C translated from the issue's redundant_mask IR reproducer; expected.ll from the issue target: (x & 2) * 9 is 0 or 18, and 18 & 22 = 18, so the final and is redundant. The issue's second function (xor to or disjoint) does not remove an instruction and is not included.
